identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy of Platinum-based Chemotherapy in Platinum-resistant Ovarian Cancer) (EPITOC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized Phase II/III Trial to Assess the Efficacy of Platinum-based Chemotherapy vs Standard Non-platinum Therapy in Patients With Platinum-resistant Recurrent Ovarian Cancer (ROC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase II/III randomized controlled trial to evaluate efficacy of platinum-based chemotherapy vs conventionally prescribed non-platinum monochemotherapy in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Recurrent ovarian cancer (ROC) is usually subdivided to platinum-sensitive (platinum-free interval \[PFI\] ≥6 mo.) and platinum-resistant ovarian cancer \[PROC\] (PFI \<6 mo.) subtypes. Prognosis for the latter group is dismal and current guidelines recommend treating these patients with non-platinum based chemotherapy. However, the evidence behind this is quite unconvincing and according to recent data patients with non-platinum refractory platinum-resistant ovarian cancer could derive benefit from platinum rechallenge. This trial is designed for head-to-head comparison of platinum and non-platinum therapy efficacy in treatment of platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (RR) according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
primaryOutcomes.description: Primary outcome for Phase II part: response rate to treatment according to RECIST1.1 criteria. For patients without measurable disease Rustin criteria is allowed.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Overall survival defined as time from randomization to death from any reason;
primaryOutcomes.description: Primary outcome for Phase III part: 2. Overall survival defined as time from randomization to death from any reason

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS) defined as time from randomization to disease progression according to RECIST 1.1 criteria or death from any reason;
Overall survival defined as time from randomization to death from any reason (for Phase II part only);
PFS2 defined as time from randomization to second disease progression event according to RECIST 1.1 criteria or death from any reason;
